finding: ProcessInputFor previews sound changes through SetPokemonCryStereo, but cancel left that live setting changed despite preserving the prior saved optionsSound.
fix: Restore SetPokemonCryStereo from the saved optionsSound after the cancel countdown and before fading out.
coverage: Both saved and preview sound values, all 21 countdown/exit invocations, restore-before-fade ordering, unchanged saved value and unrelated task, single description, final task callback.
limitations: Controlled task layout and mocked cry/fade APIs. Full option menu navigation, actual audio output and linked GBA runtime remain unverified.
